_doc: Contact part numbers the MAKER lists for each connector part number, copied from the maker's datasheet or catalog page - never inferred. audit_cavity_parts.py K4 fails a contact not listed here for its connector; a connector part number with no entry is reported as a GAP. Add one entry per connector part number: {"contacts": ["<contact PN>", ...], "source": "<datasheet title, rev, page or URL>"}.
